close_reason: Already defended at three layers: line-comment at src/methods/principal_availability.rs:40, README §Known Limitations, and tests/availability_tests.rs wire-payload assertion. Section-6 'good-decision' note, no code change required.
description:
src/methods/principal_availability.rs:40 has the line-comment `// §2.2 uses "id" not "principalId"`, and tests/availability_tests.rs:67-76 actually inspects the wire payload to verify. README.md:166-169 (Known Limitations) calls it out for users.

This is the spec-vs-intuition trap (most JMAP method args use camelCased noun names; this one is bare `id`). The author noticed and documented at three layers. Future contributors who 'helpfully' rename to `principalId` will break interop with conformant servers. Defend this.
title: wire key 'id' (not 'principalId') for Principal/getAvailability has explicit comment + test
